A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] '''mercenary''' was one of several sent to [[Hrakert Station]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]], and they were one of the few survivors after the [[Progenitor]] drove the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] staff insane. When [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his allies arrived at the station, the mercenary begged to be taken back to the surface, and when Revan headed into the station, the mercenary decided to remain in the safety of the hangar. When Revan returned to the hanger, he saw no sign of the mercenary. Instead he engaged in a [[Mission to Hrakert Station|duel]] with [[Darth Bandon]], indicating that Bandon might have [[Death/Legends|killed]] the mercenary.
